links.comparator_used: Same 30 CIED infection questions asked without additional context (generic prompt relying on built-in model knowledge)
links.outcome: Proportion of comprehensive answers (expert-graded accuracy); also word count and Flesch-Kincaid readability
links.effect: Comprehensive answers rose from 80.00% (24/30) to 93.33% (28/30) for ChatGPT 4o and from 80.00% (24/30) to 90.00% (27/30) for DeepSeek. Word count fell with guidelines (ChatGPT 4o 859.10 to 624.00; DeepSeek 526.27 to 549.43 as reported), not significant (P = .13). Readability improvements were slight and not significant (P = .11). No significant difference in overall accuracy between models (P = .34).
links.quote: The use of guideline-based prompts significantly improved the completeness of their responses.
